newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee drops as RBI buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee drops as RBI buys dollars.

text.p: The Indian rupee weakened on dollar buying by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in early interbank trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
They said the rupee weakened to 35.81 per dollar from opening quotes of 35.780/785 on RBI purchases.
"They (RBI) began buying around 35.7875," said a dealer. "The level of intervention is not clear."
He said there was some dollar demand from other banks also including the State Bank of India.
"All this has pushed the rupee down," he said.
The RBI bought dollars aggressively on Monday to push the rupee down and some dealers estimated their total purchases at $150 million.
The dollar was quoted 35.812/822 rupees in latest deals.
